18| """
19| The "updates handler".
20| 
21| This module is responsible for doing value-added work "offline" that used to be
22| done when updates were submitted.  Specifically, when someone submits an update
23| we used to:
24| 
25| - Update any bugs in bugzilla associated with the update.
26| - Check for test cases in the wiki.
27| 
28| Those things could sometimes take a *very* long time, especially if there were
29| lots of builds and lots of bugs in the update.
30| 
31| Now, update-submission breezes by those steps and simply tells the user "OK".
32| A message gets published when their update goes through, and *that* message
33| gets received here and triggers us to do all that network-laden heavy lifting.
34| """

36| import logging
37| import time
38| 
39| from sqlalchemy import func

41| from bodhi.server import util, bugs as bug_module
42| from bodhi.server.config import config
43| from bodhi.server.exceptions import BodhiException
44| from bodhi.server.models import Bug, Update, UpdateType, UpdateStatus
45| 
46| 
47| log = logging.getLogger('bodhi')
48| 
49| 
50| class UpdatesHandler:
51|     """
52|     Perform background tasks when updates are created or edited.
53| 
54|     This Celery task is run when an update is created or editied in the frontend,
55|     and performs background tasks such as modifying Bugzilla issues (and loading information from
56|     Bugzilla so we can display it to the user) and looking up wiki test cases.
57| 
58|     Attributes:
59|         db_factory (bodhi.server.util.TransactionalSessionMaker): A context manager that yields a
60|             database session.
61|         handle_bugs (bool): If True, interact with Bugzilla. Else do not.
62|     """
63| 
64|     def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
65|         """Initialize the UpdatesHandler."""
66|         self.db_factory = util.transactional_session_maker()
67| 
68|         self.handle_bugs = bool(config.get('bodhi_email'))
69|         if not self.handle_bugs:
70|             log.warning("No bodhi_email defined; not fetching bug details")
71| 
72|     def run(self, api_version: int, data: dict):
73|         """
74|         Process the given message, updating relevant bugs and test cases.
75| 
76|         Duplicate messages: if the server delivers the message multiple times,
77|         the bugs and test cases are simply re-fetched and updated, so nothing
78|         bad happens.
79| 
80|         Args:
81|             api_version: API version number.
82|             data: Information about a new or edited update.
83|         """
84|         action = data["action"]
85|         alias = data['update'].get('alias')
86| 
87|         log.info("Updates Handler handling  %s, %s" % (alias, action))
88| 
89|         # Go to sleep for a second to try and avoid a race condition
90|         # https://github.com/fedora-infra/bodhi/issues/458
91|         time.sleep(1)
92| 
93|         with self.db_factory() as session:
94|             update = Update.get(alias)
95|             if not update:
96|                 raise BodhiException("Couldn't find alias '%s' in DB" % alias)
97| 
98|             bugs = []
99|             if action == "edit":
100|                 # If editing a Pending update, all of whose builds are signed, for a release
101|                 # which isn't composed by Bodhi (i.e. Rawhide), move it directly to Testing.
102|                 if not update.release.composed_by_bodhi \
103|                         and update.status == UpdateStatus.pending \
104|                         and update.signed:
105|                     log.info("Every build in the update is signed, set status to testing")
106| 
107|                     update.status = UpdateStatus.testing
108|                     update.date_testing = func.current_timestamp()
109|                     update.request = None
110| 
111|                     log.info(f"Update status of {update.display_name} has been set to testing")
112| 
113|                 for idx in data['new_bugs']:
114|                     bug = Bug.get(idx)
115| 
116|                     # Sanity check
117|                     if bug is None or bug not in update.bugs:
118|                         update_bugs_ids = [b.bug_id for b in update.bugs]
119|                         update.update_bugs(update_bugs_ids + [idx], session)
120| 
121|                         # Now, after update.update_bugs, bug with idx should exists in DB
122|                         bug = Bug.get(idx)
123| 
124|                     bugs.append(bug)
125| 
126|             elif action == "testing":
127|                 bugs = update.bugs
128|             else:
129|                 raise NotImplementedError("Should never get here.")
130| 
131|             self.work_on_bugs(session, update, bugs)
132|             self.fetch_test_cases(session, update)
133| 
134|         if config['test_gating.required']:
135|             with self.db_factory() as session:
136|                 update = Update.get(alias)
137|                 update.update_test_gating_status()
138| 
139|         log.info("Updates Handler done with %s, %s" % (alias, action))
140| 
141|     def fetch_test_cases(self, session, update):
142|         """
143|         Query the wiki for test cases for each package on the given update.
144| 
145|         Args:
146|             session (sqlalchemy.orm.session.Session): A database session.
147|             update (bodhi.server.models.Update): The update's builds are iterated upon to find test
148|                 cases for their associated Packages..
149|         """
150|         for build in update.builds:
151|             try:
152|                 build.package.fetch_test_cases(session)
153|             except BodhiException:
154|                 log.warning('Error occurred during fetching testcases', exc_info=True)
155| 
156|     def work_on_bugs(self, session, update, bugs):
157|         """
158|         Iterate the list of bugs, retrieving information from Bugzilla and modifying them.
159| 
160|         Iterate the given list of bugs associated with the given update. For each bug, retrieve
161|         details from Bugzilla, comment on the bug to let watchers know about the update, and mark
162|         the bug as MODIFIED. If the bug is a security issue, mark the update as a security update.
163| 
164|         If handle_bugs is not True, return and do nothing.
165| 
166|         Args:
167|             session (sqlalchemy.orm.session.Session): A database session.
168|             update (bodhi.server.models.Update): The update that the bugs are associated with.
169|             bugs (list): A list of bodhi.server.models.Bug instances that we wish to act on.
170|         """
171|         if not self.handle_bugs:
172|             log.warning("Not configured to handle bugs")
173|             return
174| 
175|         log.info("Got %i bugs to sync for %r" % (len(bugs), update.alias))
176|         for bug in bugs:
177|             log.info("Getting RHBZ bug %r" % bug.bug_id)
178|             try:
179|                 rhbz_bug = bug_module.bugtracker.getbug(bug.bug_id)
180| 
181|                 log.info("Updating our details for %r" % bug.bug_id)
182|                 bug.update_details(rhbz_bug)
183|                 log.info("  Got title %r for %r" % (bug.title, bug.bug_id))
184| 
185|                 # If you set the type of your update to 'enhancement' but you
186|                 # attach a security bug, we automatically change the type of your
187|                 # update to 'security'. We need to do this first, so we don't
188|                 # accidentally comment on stuff that we shouldn't.
189|                 if bug.security:
190|                     log.info("Setting our UpdateType to security.")
191|                     update.type = UpdateType.security
192| 
193|                 log.info("Commenting on %r" % bug.bug_id)
194|                 comment = config['initial_bug_msg'] % (
195|                     update.alias, update.release.long_name, update.abs_url())
196| 
197|                 log.info("Modifying %r" % bug.bug_id)
198|                 bug.modified(update, comment)
199|             except Exception:
200|                 log.warning('Error occurred during updating single bug', exc_info=True)
